blocks.text: ILIGAN CITY — The municipal government of Poona-Piagapo in Lanao del Norte turned over nine high-powered loose firearms to the Philippine Army as part of its efforts to strengthen peace and security and pave the way for a more progressive municipality. The turnover was held on Monday at the headquarters of the Army’s 44th Infantry Battalion in Barangay Nangka, Baloi, Lanao del Norte. Poona-Piagapo Mayor Ashley Raki-in and Lt. Col. Jeremy Damonsong, 44th IB commander, underscored the importance of cooperation between the local government, security forces, and communities in sustaining peace and promoting development.
